library_dir.description: Directory to store downloaded podcast files.

config_dir.description: Directory that configuration files are stored in.

session_dir.description: Directory that session files are stored in.

cleanup_days.description: Number of days to keep files. Cleanup will remove anything older than this.

cleanup_enabled.description: Enable automatic cleanup with every run. 1 to enable, 0 to disable.

verbosity_level.description: Set verbosity level (0-4). 0 is silent, suitable for cron jobs.

feeds.description: List of feeds to monitor. Each feed is an object with url, category, name, and options.
